needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous footway along the left side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path away from the wall.
Create a pedestrian crossing at the intersection to allow safe crossing of the road.
Add a pedestrian refuge island at the signalised crossing to provide a safe area for pedestrians to wait before crossing.
Install kerb ramps at the signalised crossing to assist wheelchair users and others with mobility needs.
Install additional street lights along the road to improve visibility and safety for both pedestrians and drivers at night.
